steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: We're good on medical supplies, and we have enough fresh water and food to last for a while... Sigh...

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: I know it's hard to give up after all that preparation. But honestly? When Shin decided to turn back, I felt relieved... I had a bad feeling about this trip from the start.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Hehe, first time I've seen Shin with a kid. You two look like mother and son!
steps.female_content: Hehe, first time I've seen Shin with a kid. You two look like mother and daughter!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This is Professor Laura, my senior colleague from university. Thanks to her, we've made a lot of headway in marine research in the forbidden zone...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: And this is Reid. He's in charge of guarding the lower decks.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Yeah, it's pretty spooky down here. Any second now, monsters are gonna jump out of the shadows and... RAWR!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Alright, Reid, cut it out. Do we have enough supplies for the return journey?

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Don't worry, we're fully stocked. We're finally going home...
